description:
Blind-spot `2026-05-04-113747` surfaced two recurring weaknesses in the
/blog critique rubric for vendor-announcement response posts:

1. Currency drift between outline write date and present-day shipped
   state -- "honest deferrals" cited in an outline can become shipped
   surface within days; the rubric has no Technical-lane check that
   re-validates such claims against `git log` and `_project/TODO`/
   `_project/DONE`.
2. Partisan-reader response to framing -- vendor-response posts have a
   guaranteed adversarial reader on the source-vendor's team; framings
   that contrast (boring/novel, surface/hidden) carry the same
   substance with less bridge-burning if rephrased into technical
   specificity.

The current rubric's Risk axis mentions "stale, partisan" generically
but does not enforce a vendor-response-specific check. Adding three
cheap axis additions closes the gap.

anti_patterns.dont: make the new checks fire on every post
anti_patterns.why: gate them on 'post responds to a vendor or source-author publication' so evergreen content isn't slowed by checks that don't apply.
it stays as the generic catch-all; the new checks fire only on vendor-response posts.

preserves.behavior: Existing seven rubric rows (Thesis/Audience/Evidence/Structure/Voice/Utility/Risk) and their questions remain present.
Scoring scale (9-10/7-8/5-6/<5) and Chain-mode rules are unchanged.

verifications.description: All three new checks appear in the critique reference

work_units.notes:
Add a checklist item under the existing Risk row of
`.claude/skills/blog/references/critique.md`:
"If the outline cites blocked TODOs, honest deferrals, or 'not yet
shipped' caveats, verify them against `git log` and the current
state of `_project/TODO/` and `_project/DONE/`. Flag any item
that's actually shipped since the outline was written."
work_units.summary: Add explicit Currency check to the Risk lane

work_units.notes:
Add a checklist item: "For posts that respond to a vendor or
source-author publication, identify framings that contrast the
source against BenchBox's coverage (boring/novel, surface/hidden,
obvious/clever). Confirm each framing survives the test 'would a
reader from the source's team find this dismissive?' Substitute
technical specificity for editorial contrast where the answer is
yes."
work_units.summary: Add Partisan-Reader check to the Voice lane

work_units.notes:
Add a top-level row to the rubric table: "Shelf-life | Date the
outline against the source publication; flag if the response
window has expired (typical: 1-2 weeks after source announcement)."
Document the trigger (vendor-response posts only) inline so it
doesn't fire on evergreen content.
work_units.summary: Add Shelf-life axis (vendor-response posts have a 1-2 week peak window)
